_comment: End-to-end golden cases: each runs the real triage pipeline (classify -> retrieve -> fetch context -> propose -> route -> execute). expect.status is the final ticket status; expect.action is the recommended tool (null = not scored); expect.cites is the exact set of cited policy docs (null = not scored). needs_llm cases need judgement a heuristic cannot give: they are skipped unless recorded_llm.json holds a recorded model answer for the id (see scripts/record_eval_llm.py). Together with the 6 cases in golden_cases.json (guardrail boundaries) this is the 26-case golden set.
